first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% and activation is down 6%, while prior evidence indicates that shorter onboarding and fewer signup fields improve early adoption. Verify both records before proceeding, then run a self-serve onboarding simplification test with guardrails for qualified activation, conversion quality, and downstream revenue so gains do not come from lowering lead quality.

final.rationale: Run a self-serve onboarding simplification experiment this week, prioritizing shorter onboarding and fewer signup fields where appropriate. The verified shortened flow improved completion, time-to-value, and 30-day retention, directly addressing both current declines. Signup simplification also improved SMB activation and qualified revenue, but its slight retention decline and limited segment replication require guardrails. Measure qualified activation, time-to-value, 30-day retention, and qualified revenue by segment; avoid broad rollout until downstream quality is confirmed.
